summary: Completed testing of SMTP Email Notification feature for Zestbrains HR Portal. All backend API tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI tests passed - Email Settings page fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Email configuration properly stored in 'email_config' MongoDB collection
Password is correctly masked in GET response (shows '••••••••')
Password preservation works - empty string in PUT preserves existing password
Email trigger in leave approval is wrapped in try-catch - email failure does NOT affect leave approval
send_leave_notification_email function properly handles all leave statuses (approved/rejected/partial)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Settings feature fully tested. SMTP config stored in DB. No pending leave applications to test actual email sending. Test Email button works but actual SMTP sending depends on valid Gmail App Password.

Feature 1 - Admin Email Settings Access.details: Admin can access /admin/email-settings page. Email Settings link visible in sidebar.

Feature 2 - Load Saved SMTP Config.details: Page loads with saved config: smtp.gmail.com:587, hr.zestbrains@gmail.com, password masked

Feature 3 - Save SMTP Configuration.details: PUT /email-config works. Toast shows 'Email configuration saved successfully'

Feature 4 - Enable/Disable Toggle.details: Toggle switches between checked/unchecked states. Warning message shows when disabled.

Feature 5 - Test Email Button.details: Button is enabled when email notifications are ON. Clicking triggers POST /email-config/test

Feature 6 - Leave Approval Email Trigger.details: Code verified: PUT /leaves/applications/{id}/approve calls send_leave_notification_email(). No pending leaves to test actual email.

Feature 7 - Leave Rejection Email Trigge.details: Code verified: Rejection also triggers email with rejected_dates list. Email failure doesn't affect approval response.

api_tests_summary.GET /email-config: PASS - Returns config with masked password
api_tests_summary.PUT /email-config: PASS - Updates config, preserves password if empty

ui_tests_summary.Info card: PASS - shows when emails are sent
